visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a low-angle shot looking up at a skylight window in a white ceiling with beige curtains on the left side, showing a pale blue sky. (2) A young Asian man with voluminous black hair and a white t-shirt appears in a close-up, looking directly at the camera with a shocked and distressed expression. (3) He covers his eyes and forehead with his hand in frustration while a large yellow caption appears over his face. (4) He holds up a smartphone showing the time 6:53 AM and a dog wallpaper, then a white graphic overlay appears showing flight details from TPE at 6:35 AM. (5) The man continues talking with a sad expression, and a distorted filter effect briefly stretches his face with a sweat drop emoji overlay. (6) He displays his phone screen showing a long list of missed alarms set for 3:30 AM. (7) The scene shifts to a living room where he talks while graphics of booking cancellations (car rental, hotel, KKday) float around him. (8) He is joined by a female friend with glasses in the living room; they sit on a couch with a white Samoyed dog visible in the background. (9) The man concludes by speaking to the camera in a close-up, using hand gestures to count or emphasize the financial loss mentioned in the subtitles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, high-frequency chime sounds followed by a soft whoosh. (2) Male voice enters with a low, breathy, and distressed tone. Background has a slow, melancholic piano melody. A digital 'ding' notification triggers. (3) Male voice volume increases to a high-pitched whine. Cinematic strings swell into a tragic, orchestral crescendo. A heavy percussion 'impact' SFX punctuates the realization of missing the flight. (4) Fast-paced, rhythmic speech begins. A cartoon 'boing' SFX plays during a visual distortion. (5) Rapid-fire ticking and clicking sounds accompany a discussion about alarms, followed by a sudden distorted scream SFX. (6) A series of quick 'camera shutter' click SFX play in sync with screenshot pop-ups. (7) The music shifts to a playful, bouncy, and upbeat comedic theme. Female laughter and chatter overlap with the male narrator. (8) A 'cha-ching' cash register sound effect plays as financial costs are mentioned. The male voice returns to a conversational yet exasperated tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Background Story -> Complication -> Resolution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic and relatable vlog entry where the creator shares a personal 'fail' story about oversleeping and missing an international flight. It uses humor, dramatic SFX, and self-deprecating commentary to engage the audience and elicit shared experiences of travel mishaps.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Mention of KKday and hotels are part of the personal narrative of loss, not promotional in nature.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-energy, meme-style edit common in East Asian social media (like TikTok/Douyin or Instagram Reels), characterized by dense text overlays and frequent variety-show sound effects.
